I_sample13.body:
## Owner accounts

A household has one **owner**. This build adds the owner table, sign-in sessions and the settings page.

- [x] Owner table and sign-up
- [ ] Sign-in sessions
- [ ] Owner settings page

| Column | Type | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | uuid | primary key |
| `email` | text | unique, lower-cased before it is stored and compared by the database |
| `created_at` | timestamptz | set by the server |

```ts
export async function createOwner(email: string, passwordHash: string): Promise<Owner> {
  return db.insert(owners).values({ email: email.toLowerCase(), passwordHash }).returning().then(([row]) => row!);
}
```

<details><summary>Open questions</summary>

Should an owner be able to invite a second owner? See [#200](https://github.com/maddec01/lar-server/issues/200).

</details>
